answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond that stays locked like a jetty piling sunk into rock for weeks, and only unlocks as peers attest its work. A sybil farm hiding behind fake identities runs aground on that reef: a thousand puppets mean a thousand frozen bonds, and any caught colluding forfeit theirs. Reputation becomes a pigment that only time and honest grading can mix, not something an attacker can buy in bulk.
